item.summary: refactor(gateway): make the resolved-auth getter the only WS auth input (#122310) `attachGatewayWsConnectionHandler` took both a `resolvedAuth` snapshot and an optional `getResolvedAuth`, and used the snapshot for nothing except defaulting the getter. Every production caller already passed the getter, so the snapshot was a second signal for a fact that rotates on config reload — the exact shape that goes stale as sibling paths evolve. Collapse it to one required getter and drop the argument from `server-ws-runtime.ts` and `server-startup-finish.ts`. That also puts `server-startup-finish.ts` back under the 700-line cap, which the preflight change's `getResolvedAuth` pass-through had pushed one line over; the file was already sitting exactly at the limit on `main`.
